text: This report provides an overview of the importance of investing in Toronto's children to prevent and mitigate Adverse Childhood Experiences (ACEs). The report also describes the Child Friendly TO initiative which could serve as an effective approach for fostering healthy child development and resiliency.

The Board of Health: 1. Requested the Medical Officer of Health to review public health programs for children and adults that can prevent and mitigate the effects of Adverse Childhood Experiences (ACEs) and to report on an implementation plan.
